_comment: Prevent Damage (2026-09-27, phase I1). Dina drains 1 PER LIFEGAIN EVENT, and every Manabarbs
trigger is its own damage event. Board: Manabarbs, Tamanoa, Dina (sick; resumed at main 1),
two untapped Forests, empty hand. The pain sweep taps both Forests (a land tap is worth it with
Manabarbs + Tamanoa out): each tap -> Manabarbs deals 1 (one event) -> Tamanoa gains 1 (one
event) -> Dina drains 1. Two taps = two drains: us 20, opponent 18. An implementation that
summed the two barbs into one 2-damage event would read opponent 19.
